name: example-meeting-notes
summary: Turns meeting notes or a transcript into minutes with decisions and action items, as a DOCX.
inputs: Meeting notes, transcript (TXT or DOCX), chat log
triggers: Turn these notes into meeting minutes
Make a document of this meeting
prompt:
(Attach: [meeting notes].txt)
Turn this meeting into minutes.
The meeting is [meeting name] on [date].

situations.title: One-page summary for a report
situations.prompt:
(Attach: [transcript].docx)
Write one-page minutes that focus on the decisions.

situations.title: Action items only
situations.prompt:
(Attach: [meeting notes].txt)
Pull only the action items with an owner and a due date, as a table.

tips: Give the attendees and the date for an accurate header.
Anything missing from the notes is marked [to confirm] instead of guessed.

name: example-blog-writer
summary: Takes a topic and keywords and writes a blog post of about 1,000 words with 5 headline options.
outputs: 5 headline options + 1 blog post in MD
triggers: Write a blog post about remote work
Make a post with these keywords
prompt:
Write a blog post about [topic].
Keywords: [keyword 1], [keyword 2], [keyword 3]
Audience: [who it is for]

situations.title: Informational post
situations.prompt: Write an informational blog post that explains [topic] to someone new to it. Keywords: [keywords].

situations.title: Personal-experience post
situations.prompt:
Write a review-style blog post based on my experience.
What happened: [a few lines]
Keywords: [keywords]

tips: 3 to 5 keywords spread evenly across the headline and subheadings.
Without a length, it writes about 1,000 words.

name: example-lesson-planner
summary: Takes a course topic, audience and length and builds a session-by-session curriculum and lesson plan DOCX.
triggers: Plan a curriculum for a data literacy course
Outline a training course on customer service
prompt:
Plan a curriculum for a course on [topic].
Audience: [who is attending]
Length: [total time]

situations.title: Half-day workshop
situations.prompt: Make a 3-hour lesson plan on [topic] for [audience]. Include one hands-on exercise.

tips: Say whether the audience is new or experienced so the exercises fit.
Always give the total time; sessions are split from it.

name: example-sales-report
summary: Takes a sales spreadsheet and builds a report XLSX and one-page PDF with a monthly trend chart.
inputs: Sales data as XLSX or CSV
triggers: Analyze this spreadsheet and summarize it
prompt:
(Attach: [sales data].xlsx)
Make a monthly report from this sales data.

situations.title: Month over month only
situations.prompt:
(Attach: [sales data].xlsx)
Compare this month with last month and list only the products that went up or down.

situations.title: Top products chart
situations.prompt:
(Attach: [sales data].csv)
Chart the top 5 products by sales and make a one-page summary PDF.

tips: The file needs date, product and amount columns.
Code execution (file creation) must be turned on.
